layout.note: Paths in this manifest are relative to the repository root. Skills and agents are consumed with dotagents (agents.toml); the shared rules with scripts/sync-repo-wiring.sh.

install_targets.name: dotagents
install_targets.description: Skills and subagents, installed per project from agents.toml and pinned by agents.lock.

install_targets.name: wiring
install_targets.description: AGENTS.md managed block, CLAUDE.md stub and style guide copy, installed by scripts/sync-repo-wiring.sh.

agents.name: docs-style-reviewer
agents.description: Read-only bulk reviewer that checks documentation files against the shared style guide and reports grouped findings.

agents.name: docs-link-auditor
agents.description: Read-only auditor for broken relative links, missing or orphaned assets, and .pages navigation mismatches in a docs tree.

skills.name: docs-change-summary
skills.description: Draft reader-focused commit messages, PR titles, PR descriptions, and changelog summaries for documentation changes.

skills.name: style-guide-validator
skills.description: Validate documentation wording and formatting against a repository style guide.

skills.name: tutorial-source-to-mkdocs
skills.description: Convert tutorial source material into MkDocs-compatible documentation.

instructions.name: root-agents
instructions.description: Managed AGENTS.md block (shared rules and guardrails) for repositories that consume Content AI assets.

deprecated.install-ai-assets.sh: Bash installer kept for one release for existing consumers; migrate to dotagents. Removed in 0.5.0.
